fact: 1906年，英国皇家海军战列舰“无畏”号（HMS Dreadnought）成为新海权时代的标志：该舰由国王爱德华七世亲自命名下水，至该书写作时入列仅数月；Wikidata结构化数据记录其服役时间为1906年12月2日。

sources.title: Edward Fraser, Champions of the Fleet（London: John Lane, The Bodley Head；Project Gutenberg eBook #65978）
sources.quote: At the outset the Dreadnought had the good fortune to be named and sent afloat by His Majesty King Edward personally... the honours that have fallen to the Dreadnought's lot within the few months that our great naval masterpiece has been in existence.

sources.title: Wikidata — HMS Dreadnought (Q308909)，属性P729（服役时间）

fact: “无畏”号主炮配置颠覆既有标准：此前战列舰主炮标准为4门12英寸炮，该舰装备10门新型12英寸炮（炮管长约45英尺），侧舷交战时10门中8门可全程射击，追击或舰艏对敌时6门可用；每门炮制造需500余名工人、12至15个月工期，出厂价（不含瞄准等关键附件）1万至1.1万英镑。

sources.title: Edward Fraser, Champions of the Fleet（Project Gutenberg eBook #65978）
sources.quote: Hitherto four 12-inch guns have formed the standard main armament for all battleships. The Dreadnought carries ten 12-inch guns of a new and more powerful type... huge cannon, each forty-five feet long... The manufacture of one of the Dreadnought's guns, separately, employs in its manufacture from first to last upwards of five hundred men in various capacities, and costs, as turned out ready to send on board, but without sighting and other vital appliances, between £10,000 and £11,000.

fact: “无畏”号是世界第一艘以帕森斯蒸汽轮机（Parsons turbine）推进的战列舰，航速21节，比当时任何现役战列舰快整整2节；侧舷、炮塔与指挥塔装甲为11英寸克虏伯钢。

sources.title: Edward Fraser, Champions of the Fleet（Project Gutenberg eBook #65978）
sources.quote: Her speed of twenty-one knots makes her a full two knots faster than any existing battleship. She is the first battleship in any navy to be propelled by the Parsons turbine, to which her speed is due... The Dreadnought carries eleven inches of Krupp steel armour on her sides, turrets, and conning tower.

fact: “无畏”号官方造价为1,797,497英镑，工期16个月，排水量17,900吨；对比表中特拉法加海战名舰“胜利”号造价89,000英镑——无畏舰时代单舰资本开支较18—19世纪主力舰上升逾20倍。

sources.title: Edward Fraser, Champions of the Fleet（Project Gutenberg eBook #65978，Dreadnought与Victory对比表）
sources.quote: Lastly, the cost of the Dreadnought is officially stated at £1,797,497... DREADNOUGHT / VICTORY — Time Building: 16 months / Five years ten months; Total Cost: £1,797,497 / £89,000; Displacement: 17,900 tons / 3400 tons.

fact: 1906年8月第一个周一，本土舰队在考斯（Cowes）外海举行大检阅后，国王爱德华七世、王后亚历山德拉、王储夫妇及第一海务大臣约翰·费舍尔爵士登舰，观看“无畏”号12英寸炮塔炮射击演示：2,640码距离上，4门开火的12英寸炮在2分半内12发打出9个正中目标与2个近失。

sources.title: Edward Fraser, Champions of the Fleet（Project Gutenberg eBook #65978）
sources.quote: after the great review of the Home Fleet off Cowes, on the first Monday of August this year, when King Edward, with Queen Alexandra, the Prince of Wales... with Sir John Fisher and members of the Royal suite, went out on board the Dreadnought to beyond Spithead to witness target-practice with the Dreadnought's turret-guns; the memorable occasion on which, at 2640 yards' range, the four 12-in. guns that fired, scored within two and a half minutes nine bull's-eyes and two 'outers' out of twelve rounds discharged.

fact: “无畏”号火炮与防护数据：侧射弹重合计6,800磅（“胜利”号1,160磅），火炮极端射程25英里，6英里处可击穿9英寸克虏伯装甲；单发发射装药为265磅“改进型”柯达火药；舰体长490英尺、自上甲板至龙骨约60英尺。

fact: 无畏舰时代的重炮制造是劳动密集的高技能产业：单门12英寸炮需要500余名各类工人、12—15个月制造周期，单价1万—1.1万英镑；整舰16个月建成——炮厂、装甲钢与轮机的分包订单节奏由这类长周期共同决定。

fact: 英国贸易部1906年工资普查（报告编号Cd.4545，1909年出版）记录了棉纺织业的周工资水平：曼彻斯特区梳棉与清花男工（strippers and grinders等）的周工资从1886年的21先令5便士升至1906年的28先令11便士，兰开夏与柴郡同期从20先令4便士升至29先令5便士；1906年普查中粗支细纱工（coarse spinners）的下四分位工资为33先令6便士，细支细纱工（fine spinners）的上四分位为50先令6便士，细纱工整体周工资区间约30至55先令；梳棉工长（carding overlooker）1906年平均周工资39先令2便士。这是1906年前后英国工业城市成年男性工人工资最接近当年的官方普查锚点。

In 1906, the lower quartiles of coarse spinners in Lancashire and Cheshire is 33s. 6d., and the upper quartiles of fine spinners is 50s. 6d., so that a range of from 30s. to 55s. is still possible ... fact: 1906年《贸易争端法》（Trade Disputes Act 1906，6 Edw. 7 c. 47）于1906年12月21日获御准并即日生效，长标题为“An Act to provide for the regulation of Trades Unions and Trade Disputes”。该法向1875年《阴谋与财产保护法》增补关键条款：‘An act done in pursuance of an agreement or combination by two or more persons shall, if done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute, not be actionable unless the act, if done without any such agreement or combination, would be actionable.’——只要行为属于争端筹划或推进中的集体行为，除非单独实施本身即可诉，否则不可诉，实质逆转了1901年塔夫谷案（Taff Vale）确立的工会损害赔偿责任，并使和平纠察（peaceful picketing）合法化。该法直至1971年才被废止。

sources.title: Wikipedia — Trade Disputes Act 1906（含法案长标题、御准日期与核心条款原文；引 Hansard HC vol. col.1490 (25 April 1906)、Wilson, CB. A Life of Sir Henry Campbell-Bannerman、Dicey/Schumpeter 评述）
sources.quote: The Trade Disputes Act 1906 (6 Edw. 7. c. 47) was an act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom passed under the Campbell-Bannerman administration which provided that trade unions could not be sued for damages resulting from industrial action. Its key reform was to add to the Conspiracy and Protection of Property Act 1875 the famous words, "An act done in pursuance of an agreement or combination by two or more persons shall, if done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute, not be actionable unless the act, if done without any such agreement or combination, would be actionable." ... Royal assent: 21 December 1906; Commencement: 21 December 1906 ... [Schumpeter:] in relaxing the law of conspiracy in respect to peaceful picketing—and in exempting trade-union funds from liability in action for damages for torts—which practically amounted to enacting that trade unions could do no wrong
